metadata.blurb: Trust Wallet is a multi-chain self-custody wallet for mobile and browser extension users.

ref.explanation: Trust Wallet support says wallets can be imported using a secret phrase, also known as a recovery phrase, seed phrase, or mnemonic.
Trust Wallet supports ENS and Web3 domain-name resolution in its wallet UI.
Trust Wallet presents swaps and cross-chain features as part of its multi-chain wallet experience.
Trust Wallet says it supports 100+ blockchains from one self-custody wallet.
Trust Wallet is available as a browser extension for connecting to Web3 dapps.
Trust Wallet's full consumer app source is not published as a single open-source app repository; Trust Wallet Core is an Apache-2.0 library used by the wallet.
Trust Wallet support documents importing wallets from mobile to extension, extension to mobile, and from other Web3 wallets.
Trust Wallet's App Store privacy label lists Diagnostics as data that may be collected.
Trust Wallet's privacy notice describes automatic collection and use of personal data through its applications and services.
Trust Wallet's security page links to and describes a bug bounty program.
Trust Wallet public docs describe multi-chain wallet network access, but no embedded Ethereum L1 light-client verification path was found.
Trust Wallet's Security Scanner is designed to protect assets by alerting users of risky transactions and providing risk descriptions.
Trust Wallet's security page describes built-in risk monitoring tools and security partners that help users avoid scams.
Trust Wallet's Security Scanner alerts users of risky transactions before signing.
Trust Wallet's Security Scanner evaluates transaction risk and shows risk descriptions before users proceed.
Trust Wallet announced an Approvals feature that lets users view active approvals, detect risky approvals, and revoke approvals directly inside the mobile wallet and extension.
Trust Wallet public docs describe app-managed network access; no self-hosted-node transaction broadcast configuration was found.
Trust Wallet publishes app-store and extension releases, but no independently verifiable signed application artifacts were found.
Trust Wallet Core publishes public GitHub releases with changelog entries.
Trust Wallet does not publish reproducible build instructions for the full consumer wallet apps.
